prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Palladium (Pd) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a kitchen or galley in her element's kingdom
Light direction: a low warm light source near her — a lamp, a fire or a screen — glowing on her from below shoulder height.
Outfit: a spa robe open over a swimsuit — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, rust, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing close to a high shelf or line, reaching up to it.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her — her own right hand under the right side of the box, her own left hand under the left side.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — palladium: a soft silver-white metal that never tarnishes, named for the asteroid Pallas, found the year before and itself named for Pallas Athena, goddess of wisdom; in 1803 it was first offered anonymously as a new silver in a small London shop, with a reward promised to anyone who could make it themselves; at room temperature it soaks up hydrogen like a sponge, up to nine hundred times its own volume, and a thin palladium sheet lets only hydrogen pass through; it cleans car exhaust as a catalyst and whitens gold — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: curvy — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

observations: 1024x1536 verified. Adult figure; face, hair colour and body broadly consistent with attached selected world. No extra, disconnected or reversed limb observed; occluded fingers are not fully countable.
Two hands hold the box on a shelf; owl and leaf motifs have transferred onto casual clothing.
qa.cause: Reference motifs are explicitly allowed by generated Her element clause, conflicting with the general casual no-clothing-motif instruction; pose/crop differences described in observations.
